   202	        (divRepPullAtAff hpi g r1 r2 b1 b2 U (ci p) (cj p) (cw p)) =
   203	      DivFamZarAff.mapAlgHom (DivFamZar.awayMulRight (k := k) f p q)
   204	        (divRepPullAtAff hpi g r1 r2 b1 b2 U (ci q) (cj q) (cw q)) := by
   205	  classical
   206	  letI : Algebra (Localization.Away (f p)) (Localization.Away (f p * f q)) :=
   207	    (DivFamZar.awayMulLeft (k := k) f p q).toRingHom.toAlgebra
   208	  letI : Algebra (Localization.Away (f q)) (Localization.Away (f p * f q)) :=
   209	    (DivFamZar.awayMulRight (k := k) f p q).toRingHom.toAlgebra
   210	  haveI : IsScalarTower S (Localization.Away (f p))
   211	      (Localization.Away (f p * f q)) :=
   212	    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq' (RingHom.ext fun x => by
   213	      rw [RingHom.comp_apply, RingHom.algebraMap_toAlgebra]
   214	      exact (DivFamZar.awayMulOfDvd_algebraMap
   215	        (k := k) (f p * f q) (f p) (f q) rfl x).symm)
   216	  haveI : IsScalarTower S (Localization.Away (f q))
   217	      (Localization.Away (f p * f q)) :=
   218	    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq' (RingHom.ext fun x => by
   219	      rw [RingHom.comp_apply, RingHom.algebraMap_toAlgebra]
   220	      exact (DivFamZar.awayMulOfDvd_algebraMap
   221	        (k := k) (f p * f q) (f q) (f p) (mul_comm _ _) x).symm)
   222	  haveI : IsScalarTower k (Localization.Away (f p))
   223	      (Localization.Away (f p * f q)) :=
   224	    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq' (RingHom.ext fun x => by
   225	      rw [RingHom.comp_apply, RingHom.algebraMap_toAlgebra]
   226	      exact ((DivFamZar.awayMulLeft (k := k) f p q).commutes x).symm)
   227	  haveI : IsScalarTower k (Localization.Away (f q))
   228	      (Localization.Away (f p * f q)) :=
   229	    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq' (RingHom.ext fun x => by
   230	      rw [RingHom.comp_apply, RingHom.algebraMap_toAlgebra]
   231	      exact ((DivFamZar.awayMulRight (k := k) f p q).commutes x).symm)
   232	  have hL : IsScalarTower.toAlgHom k (Localization.Away (f p))
   233	      (Localization.Away (f p * f q)) = DivFamZar.awayMulLeft (k := k) f p q :=
   234	    AlgHom.ext fun x => by
   235	      change algebraMap (Localization.Away (f p)) (Localization.Away (f p * f q)) x = _
   236	      rw [RingHom.algebraMap_toAlgebra]
   237	      rfl
   238	  have hR : IsScalarTower.toAlgHom k (Localization.Away (f q))
   239	      (Localization.Away (f p * f q)) = DivFamZar.awayMulRight (k := k) f p q :=
   240	    AlgHom.ext fun x => by
   241	      change algebraMap (Localization.Away (f q)) (Localization.Away (f p * f q)) x = _
   242	      rw [RingHom.algebraMap_toAlgebra]
   243	      rfl
   244	  rw [← hL, ← hR]
   245	  exact divRepPullAtAff_mapAlgHom_eq_of_chartFactor hpi g hO hchi
   246	    r1 r2 b1 b2 U hU v (cw p) (cw q) (hcw p) (hcw q)
   247	
   248	set_option maxHeartbeats 2400000 in
   249	-- Atlas factorization, widened class gluing, and classifier naturality elaborate together.
   250	/-- Every affine morphism to `DivScheme` is classified once every chart map is in range. -/
   251	theorem exists_divRepClassifyZarAff_eq_of_chartRange
   252	    (U : ∀ (i : (glueData k g r1).J) (j : (glueData k g r2).J),
   253	      DivFamZarAff C (ChartRing i j) g)
   254	    (hU : ∀ i j,
   255	      (divRepClassifyZarAff hpi g hO hchi r1 r2 b1 b2
   256	        (ChartRing i j) (U i j)).left = ChartMap i j)
   257	    (S : Type u) [CommRing S] [Algebra k S] (v : overSpec k S ⟶ DivOver) :
   258	    ∃ F : DivFamZarAff C S g,
   259	      divRepClassifyZarAff hpi g hO hchi r1 r2 b1 b2 S F = v := by
   260	  classical
   261	  obtain ⟨m, f, hspan, hdata⟩ := divScheme_exists_chartFactor
   262	    k (windowS_choice pi hpi g • fiberWeilDivisor pi)
   263	      (windowM_choice pi hpi g • fiberWeilDivisor pi) g r1 r2 b1
   264	      (b2.map (windowShiftEquiv hpi g).symm) S v
   265	  choose ci cj cw hcw using hdata
   266	  obtain ⟨F, hF⟩ := DivFamZarAff.exists_glue_of_awaySpan f hspan
   267	    (fun t => divRepPullAtAff hpi g r1 r2 b1 b2 U (ci t) (cj t) (cw t))
   268	    (divRepPullAtAff_awayMul_compat hpi g hO hchi r1 r2 b1 b2
   269	      U hU v f ci cj cw hcw)
   270	  refine ⟨F, ?_⟩
   271	  apply Over.OverMorphism.ext
   272	  refine Scheme.Cover.hom_ext
   273	    (Scheme.affineOpenCoverOfSpanRangeEqTop (R := CommRingCat.of S) f hspan).openCover
   274	      _ _ fun t => ?_
   275	  let q : Fin m := t
   276	  let phi : S →ₐ[k] Localization.Away (f q) :=
   277	    IsScalarTower.toAlgHom k S (Localization.Away (f q))
   278	  change Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom phi.toRingHom) ≫
   279	      (divRepClassifyZarAff hpi g hO hchi r1 r2 b1 b2 S F).left =
   280	    Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom phi.toRingHom) ≫ v.left
   281	  calc
   282	    _ = (divRepClassifyZarAff hpi g hO hchi r1 r2 b1 b2
   283	        (Localization.Away (f q)) (DivFamZarAff.mapAlgHom phi F)).left :=
   284	      specMap_comp_divRepClassifyZarAff hpi g hO hchi r1 r2 b1 b2 phi F
   285	    _ = (divRepClassifyZarAff hpi g hO hchi r1 r2 b1 b2
   286	        (Localization.Away (f q))
   287	          (divRepPullAtAff hpi g r1 r2 b1 b2 U (ci q) (cj q) (cw q))).left := by
   288	      rw [hF q]
   289	    _ = Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (cw q).toRingHom) ≫
   290	        (divRepClassifyZarAff hpi g hO hchi r1 r2 b1 b2
   291	          (ChartRing (ci q) (cj q)) (U (ci q) (cj q))).left :=
   292	      (specMap_comp_divRepClassifyZarAff hpi g hO hchi
   293	        r1 r2 b1 b2 (cw q) (U (ci q) (cj q))).symm
   294	    _ = Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (cw q).toRingHom) ≫
   295	        ChartMap (ci q) (cj q) := by rw [hU (ci q) (cj q)]
   296	    _ = Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom phi.toRingHom) ≫ v.left := by
   297	      have hphi : phi.toRingHom = algebraMap S (Localization.Away (f q)) := rfl
   298	      rw [hphi]
   299	      exact hcw q
   300	
   301	/-- Chart-range witnesses represent the widened divisor functor by `DivScheme`. -/
   302	noncomputable def divFunctorAff_representableBy_of_chartRange
   303	    (U : ∀ (i : (glueData k g r1).J) (j : (glueData k g r2).J),
   304	      DivFamZarAff C (ChartRing i j) g)
   305	    (hU : ∀ i j,
   306	      (divRepClassifyZarAff hpi g hO hchi r1 r2 b1 b2
   307	        (ChartRing i j) (U i j)).left = ChartMap i j) :
   308	    (divFunctorAff C g).RepresentableBy DivOver :=
   309	  DivRepAffinePullbackAff.representableBy hpi g hO hchi r1 r2 b1 b2
   310	    (DivRepAffinePullbackAff.ofClassifierSurjective hpi g hO hchi r1 r2 b1 b2
   311	      (fun S _ _ v =>
   312	        exists_divRepClassifyZarAff_eq_of_chartRange
   313	          hpi g hO hchi r1 r2 b1 b2 U hU S v))
   314

     6	import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.DivRepChartRangeAff

     8	/-!
     9	# The widened classifier-clause endpoint
    10	
    11	`DivRepChartRangeAff` proves widened classifier surjectivity from a class on every carve chart
    12	whose classifier is the chart map.  A universal certified family naturally supplies the
    13	stronger characterizing clause `IsDivRepClassifyAff`, rather than that equality directly.
    14	This file is the small bridge between those interfaces; it does not duplicate the atlas
    15	factorization or away-span gluing.
    16	
    17	## Main declarations
    18	
    19	* `AlgebraicGeometry.DivRepChartFamilyAff.IsChartClause` -- every universal chart class
    20	  satisfies the widened classifier clause at the canonical chart map.
    21	* `AlgebraicGeometry.divRepClassifyZarAff_surjective_of_chartClause` -- the clause implies
    22	  classifier surjectivity via the chart-range theorem.
    23	* `AlgebraicGeometry.divFunctorAff_representableBy_of_chartClause` -- the final widened
    24	  representability producer in the clause spelling.
    25	-/
    26	
    27	set_option autoImplicit false
    28	set_option quotPrecheck false
    29	set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false
    30	set_option maxSynthPendingDepth 3
    31	
    32	universe u
    33	
    34	open CategoryTheory
    35	
    36	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
    37	
    38	open Grassmannian Scheme
    39	
    40	section Curve
    41	
    42	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))}
    43	variable {pi : C.left ⟶ P1 k} [IsFinite pi]
    44	
    45	noncomputable local instance instOverCleftDivRepClassifyZarAffSurj :
    46	    C.left.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) := ⟨C.hom⟩
    47	
    48	variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 (C.left ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))]
    49	  [IsIntegral C.left]
    50	  [LocallyOfFiniteType (C.left ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))]
    51	  [QuasiCompact (C.left ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))]
    52	  [IsDominant pi]
    53	variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
    54	  [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]
    55	variable [Module.Finite k (Sheaf.HModule (C.left.moduleKSheaf k) 0)]
    56	  [Module.Finite k (Sheaf.HModule (C.left.moduleKSheaf k) 1)]
    57	variable (hpi : pi ≫ P1.structureMap k = C.left ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))
    58	variable (g : ℕ)
    59	variable (hO : Sheaf.h0 (C.left.moduleKSheaf k) = 1)
    60	variable (hchi : Sheaf.chi (C.left.moduleKSheaf k) = 1 - (g : ℤ))
    61	variable (r1 r2 : ℕ)
    62	variable (b1 : Module.Basis (Fin r1) k
    63	  ↥(divisorSections k (windowM_choice pi hpi g • fiberWeilDivisor pi) ⊤))
    64	variable (b2 : Module.Basis (Fin r2) k
    65	  ↥(divisorSections k
    66	    ((windowM_choice pi hpi g + windowS_choice pi hpi g) • fiberWeilDivisor pi) ⊤))
    67	
    68	local notation "DivOver" =>
    69	  divSchemeOver k (windowS_choice pi hpi g • fiberWeilDivisor pi)
    70	    (windowM_choice pi hpi g • fiberWeilDivisor pi) g r1 r2 b1
    71	    (b2.map (windowShiftEquiv hpi g).symm)
    72	
    73	local notation "ChartRing" => fun i j =>
    74	  DivCarveChartRing k (windowS_choice pi hpi g • fiberWeilDivisor pi)
    75	    (windowM_choice pi hpi g • fiberWeilDivisor pi) g r1 r2 b1
    76	    (b2.map (windowShiftEquiv hpi g).symm) i j
    77	
    78	local notation "ChartMap" => fun i j =>
    79	  divCarveChartToDivScheme k (windowS_choice pi hpi g • fiberWeilDivisor pi)
    80	    (windowM_choice pi hpi g • fiberWeilDivisor pi) g r1 r2 b1
    81	    (b2.map (windowShiftEquiv hpi g).symm) i j
    82	
    83	namespace DivRepChartFamilyAff
    84	
    85	/-- Every supplied widened chart class is classified by its canonical chart map. -/
    86	def IsChartClause
    87	    (U : ∀ (i : (glueData k g r1).J) (j : (glueData k g r2).J),
    88	      DivFamZarAff C (ChartRing i j) g) : Prop :=
    89	  ∀ (i : (glueData k g r1).J) (j : (glueData k g r2).J),
    90	    IsDivRepClassifyAff hpi g r1 r2 b1 b2 (U i j) (ChartMap i j)
    91	
    92	end DivRepChartFamilyAff
    93	
    94	include hO hchi in
    95	/-- The characterizing clause identifies the canonical classifier with the chart map. -/
    96	theorem divRepClassifyZarAff_left_eq_chartMap
    97	    (U : ∀ (i : (glueData k g r1).J) (j : (glueData k g r2).J),
    98	      DivFamZarAff C (ChartRing i j) g)
    99	    (hU : DivRepChartFamilyAff.IsChartClause (hpi := hpi) g r1 r2 b1 b2 U)
   100	    (i : (glueData k g r1).J) (j : (glueData k g r2).J) :
   101	    (divRepClassifyZarAff hpi g hO hchi r1 r2 b1 b2 (ChartRing i j) (U i j)).left
   102	      = ChartMap i j :=
   103	  isDivRepClassifyAff_unique hpi g hO hchi r1 r2 b1 b2 (U i j)
   104	    (divRepClassifyZarAff_isDivRepClassifyAff hpi g hO hchi r1 r2 b1 b2 (U i j))
   105	    (hU i j)
   106	
   107	include hO hchi in
   108	/-- The clause form of the universal chart family implies affine classifier surjectivity. -/
   109	theorem divRepClassifyZarAff_surjective_of_chartClause
   110	    (U : ∀ (i : (glueData k g r1).J) (j : (glueData k g r2).J),
   111	      DivFamZarAff C (ChartRing i j) g)
   112	    (hU : DivRepChartFamilyAff.IsChartClause (hpi := hpi) g r1 r2 b1 b2 U)
   113	    (S : Type u) [CommRing S] [Algebra k S] :
   114	    Function.Surjective
   115	      (divRepClassifyZarAff (C := C) (pi := pi) hpi g hO hchi r1 r2 b1 b2 S) :=
   116	  fun v => exists_divRepClassifyZarAff_eq_of_chartRange
   117	    hpi g hO hchi r1 r2 b1 b2 U
   118	      (divRepClassifyZarAff_left_eq_chartMap hpi g hO hchi r1 r2 b1 b2 U hU) S v
   119	
   120	include hO hchi in
   121	/-- Universal widened chart classes satisfying the characterizing clause represent the
   122	widened divisor functor by `DivScheme`. -/
   123	noncomputable def divFunctorAff_representableBy_of_chartClause
   124	    (U : ∀ (i : (glueData k g r1).J) (j : (glueData k g r2).J),
   125	      DivFamZarAff C (ChartRing i j) g)
   126	    (hU : DivRepChartFamilyAff.IsChartClause (hpi := hpi) g r1 r2 b1 b2 U) :
   127	    (divFunctorAff C g).RepresentableBy DivOver :=
   128	  divFunctorAff_representableBy_of_chartRange hpi g hO hchi r1 r2 b1 b2 U
   129	    (divRepClassifyZarAff_left_eq_chartMap hpi g hO hchi r1 r2 b1 b2 U hU)
   130	
   131	end Curve
